description: Search tracked mentions for your organization. Filter by keyword, platform, status (open, ignored, done), relevant, minimum relevance, minimum confidence (0 to 1), sentiment, intent, free text (q, the post text or the author name), time range (ISO 8601), one person (personId from list_people), assignee (assigneeId), author reach (minFollowers, maxFollowers), engagement the platform reported (minLikes, minReposts, minReplies, minQuotes, minViews, minBookmarks; a post without the count never passes), review stars (ratings, or notRatings to leave some out), author tags (tags, any-of), the hosts a post links to (linkHosts, any-of, a host or any subdomain of it), replies against top-level posts (isReply), posts against comments (kind: post or comment), whether the post reads as machine-made (automated=true for the bots, false for the rest), an alert rule's whole filter (alertId, the same mentions the rule would send), a saved view's filter (viewId, from list_views, ANDed with the rest), the kind of keyword that matched (keywordKinds: brand, competitor, topic), or the keyword's group (groupIds, or notGroupIds to leave groups out; ids from list_groups). Every filter is ANDed; for OR, anyOf takes up to 10 groups of the same conditions (an object each, all its conditions ANDed) and keeps a mention when at least one group holds, on top of the rest: anyOf=[{platforms:["reddit"],sentiments:["negative"]},{intents:["buy_intent"]}]. Snoozed mentions are hidden unless snoozed=true. sort="newest" (default) or "priority" (attention score from relevance, author reach, intent and age, over the last 30 days of matches only; each mention carries it as `priority`). Returns 10 mentions by default (limit, up to 100). Each mention nests post, author, classification and triage. A cross-post (the same author posting the same text again for the same keyword within three days, like one announcement in five subreddits) is listed once: the original carries the others in duplicates; includeDuplicates=true lists them separately, each with duplicateOf.

alertId.description: Apply an alert rule's filter (an id from GET /v1/alerts) on top of the other filters: the same mentions the rule would send, for a feed-shaped export or a preview. Unknown ids are a 404.

anyOf.description: OR across groups: a mention passes when it meets every condition of at least one group (1 to 10 groups). The other conditions still apply to every mention: the whole filter is (other conditions) AND (group 1 OR group 2 ...). A group takes the conditions of a view filter (platforms, sentiments, intents, keywordKinds, the not lists ...), with no anyOf of its own.

since.description: Only posts published at or after this instant (ISO 8601, or epoch ms).

snoozed.description: true: only mentions currently snoozed. Otherwise snoozed mentions stay out until they wake.

sort.description: newest: by match time, newest first. priority: by attention score, highest first; priority ranks the last 30 days of matches only, older ones stay reachable under newest. Cursors are specific to a sort.

status.description: Only mentions in this status. Omit for every status.

tags.description: Only authors your workspace tagged with any of these (exact, case-sensitive). Repeatable, or comma-separated.

until.description: Only posts published at or before this instant (ISO 8601, or epoch ms).

viewId.description: Apply a saved view's filter (an id from GET /v1/views) on top of the other filters, every condition ANDed: exactly what the view selects. Unknown ids are a 404.
